visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-framed glasses and a patterned anime-style shirt stands on a busy Japanese urban street with tall commercial buildings and colorful signage in the background. (2) A close-up static shot displays a vertical poster for a Detective Conan collaboration with McDonald's, followed by an image of a burger. (3) Hands receive a brown paper food bag over a service counter. (4) In an indoor setting, the man sits at a wooden table and unboxes a red burger container featuring Conan Edogawa's face. He holds up the burger, showing a bun with a unique protrusion on top. (5) The man takes a large bite of the burger while looking at the camera, then drinks from a transparent plastic cup decorated with Detective Conan characters. (6) Close-up shots show the different sides of the burger box and the man rotating the cup to reveal layered character illustrations. (7) The man eats a golden-brown hash brown. (8) In a parody sequence, the man sits slumped in a chair with his chin on his chest. A red flash filter and a comic-style speech bubble graphic appear. (9) A close-up of the empty transparent cup is shown against a bright window, demonstrating how the illustrations of Shinichi, Ran, and Conan interact as the cup rotates.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 前幾天我走在日本街頭. (2) [Subtitle]: 我發現日本麥當勞竟然有賣小蘭角. (3) [Subtitle]: 不是，小蘭角為原型設計出來的漢堡. (4) [Logo]: Detective Conan. [Logo]: McDonald's. (5) [Subtitle]: 這個是?! 這怎麼可能?! (6) [Subtitle]: 其實我也不知道我點的這個是什麼? (7) [Subtitle]: 我只知道他的漢堡皮上面是一個小蘭角... 不是小蘭角. (8) [Variety]: 尖叫聲!!. (9) [Subtitle]: 他的漢堡皮非常軟，然後呢，他裡面的肉呢，應該是豬肉. (10) [Subtitle]: 我以為是蝦餅，但不是，他是豬肉. (11) [Subtitle]: 原來小蘭角... 不是小蘭角是這個味道啊. (12) [Subtitle]: 漢堡的包裝呢，正面是柯南，旁邊呢是毛利，毛利一家，以及勇員們，灰原. (13) [Subtitle]: 他這聯名的杯子呢，這一面是小蘭跟柯南，背面呢是說了一句說：我還有案件要處理. (14) [Subtitle]: 就丟下女朋友跑走的，負心漢工藤新一. (15) [Subtitle]: 他的套餐呢還有附一個薯餅. (16) [Variety]: (話劇社期末成發). (17) [Subtitle]: 兇手就是... 我. (18) [Subtitle]: 然後我發現這個杯子，只要轉到正面，新一就會在後面尾隨柯南跟小蘭喔.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a dense Japanese urban area (Shinjuku) with high-rise buildings and bright billboards. It transitions to an indoor dining area with a round wooden table, neutral beige curtains, and soft window lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced male narration begins with a neutral but engaging tone, accompanied by distant street traffic hum and the rustle of a paper bag. (2) A brief, polite Japanese female vocal says 'Arigato gozaimasu' as the bag is handled. (3) An energetic orchestral background music track featuring bright violins and upbeat drums kicks in, synchronized with the unboxing of food. (4) Clear, percussive 'crunch' sounds are audible as the man bites into the burger and hash brown. (5) The music shifts abruptly to a dramatic, tense orchestral stinger during a parody sequence where the man's vocal tone becomes breathless and exaggerated, mimicking an anime suspense scene. (6) The audio concludes with a return to the upbeat music as the speaker points out a hidden visual detail on the drink cup.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Experience -> Product Detail -> Comedy Parody -> Final Discovery
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To review the Detective Conan x McDonald's limited edition burger in Japan, focusing on its unique bun shape (inspired by Ran Mouri's hair) and packaging details through a mix of informative review and comedic anime parody.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While featuring McDonald's heavily, the style is a personal travel/food vlog rather than a paid commercial endorsement.
